episode: The Cat Who Became a Box
readme: PROVISIONAL EDITORIAL PLAN — not a Remotion render manifest. Audio has not been generated or aligned. Before implementation, replace estimateStartFrame/estimateEndFrame using authorized actual narration timings. Do not use these estimates to call paid services or full render.

shots.cameraAndAction: Single uninterrupted wide-city establishing push: first frame above complete living neighborhood, approach the THREE CATS cafe block and a sidewalk box with kitten visible; moving street traffic and shoppers, never inside opaque geometry.
shots.soundCue: City ambience; cardboard scrape; curious low note

shots.narrationAnchor: stays inside a box too long
shots.cameraAndAction: NO CUT: continue Shot 01's same camera, target and lens across frame 84; one continuous pan/dolly/zoom closes on the same sidewalk box and original kitten, which smoothly settles into a curled posture without any pose or flap jump. Review real 105 consecutive frames as one take.
Readable one-shot feline-to-cardboard transformation, living kitten visible before ears/paws become papery folds of the SAME box. No cat simply disappears behind flaps.
shots.soundCue: Magic paper-fold hit and bass punctuation

shots.cameraAndAction: Show another already-boxed cat reacting from a separate twitching carton; nearby shoppers recoil. Pure visual story with no giant signs.
Mocha approaches café, grimaces at an ordinary empty carton and sidesteps it, without touching it.
Close on chocolate-point Latte purring in SMALL STRIPED-TAPE box at FIXED café window location.
shots.soundCue: Happy purr and precise paper creaks

shots.narrationAnchor: Essie slept in her cardboard box
shots.cameraAndAction: Match cut: black/white Essie in LARGE PLAIN box at fixed café sleeping corner. She leaves a space and invites Mocha with a paw; he walks past. Night/dawn passage.
shots.soundCue: Soft sleep breath and fabric rustle

shots.cameraAndAction: Morning exterior: Mocha follows established pavement route toward café with opening keys; door visible.
OTS doorway: Mocha scans counter, floor and empty space near window; worried eye movement.

shots.narrationAnchor: striped box was still beneath the window
shots.cameraAndAction: Tracking detail reveals SAME STRIPED box unmoved at window, one flap twitching.
Tight face closeup on Mocha calling toward striped box; eyes fixed on its position.
Close paw-contact shot: Mocha lifts first then second flap; no mesh intersections.
Low box-interior POV looking up at Mocha; hollow cavity; familiar muffled Latte meow from cardboard.
Mocha reacts, looking from empty carton interior to familiar striped exterior.
Wider picture: Mocha and transformed striped box in same window location; box lightly shudders.
Mocha places fish treat at box opening, then gently rocks box once; playable distinct motions.

shots.narrationAnchor: begged it to move / Nothing worked
shots.cameraAndAction: Mocha kneels, pleads, waits for box to move, then lowers head; background patrons still in world.
Café medium OTS from register: Mocha watches Essie near her LARGE PLAIN box; same two-counter geometry.
Side close as Essie puts front paws into her box and eases toward a curl.
Motivated camera follow: Mocha gently scoops Essie onto safe floor mat, correctly grounded.
Reverse CU: Essie tilts head then glances toward beloved box, never floating off ground.
Medium: Essie lies on exposed café mat while her box remains visible but out of reach; Mocha nearby.
Mocha notices her forlorn face, then glances toward Latte's striped box; no dialogue.
Night: Mocha flips closed sign and tidies cups; practical café windows glow; customers gone.
Interior wide includes Mocha and empty sleeping spot; he scans the dark street from doorway.
Motivated push into Essie's corner: characteristic floor mat remains, LARGE PLAIN box gone.
Continuous threshold move: Mocha runs through open café door onto same street pavement.
shots.soundCue: Door hinge and urgent paw beats

shots.cameraAndAction: Night wide at established bus shelter; Mocha peers around vacant bench then moves on.
Tracking past closed market-front stalls; screen-left to screen-right route continuous.
Low tracking through first alley: Mocha inspects bins, steps back into lit lane.
Long shot from high alley mouth: isolated streetlamp reveals tiny Essie silhouette beyond.
Medium side view: Essie drags same LARGE PLAIN box by flap onto paved sheltered corner; readable paws, cardboard contact.
Mocha at far end calls; fast push-in to his outstretched paw.
shots.soundCue: Urgent Mocha meow at exact call

shots.cameraAndAction: Long-axis reverse: Essie deep in frame doesn't hear; Mocha remains far down the lane.
Box lip angle: Essie curls into large box beneath lamp and slowly closes eyes.
Tracking lower legs/paws: Mocha sprints along continuous mapped alley, past drain and bins.
Close inside box after implied time passing: Essie's fur edge subtly turns papery; silhouette starts folding.
Stable side close: her paws flatten into cardboard folds, whiskers retract, no extra prop suddenly appears.

shots.narrationAnchor: Essie folded into a cardboard box
shots.cameraAndAction: One medium unbroken shot: Mocha enters foreground as Essie's last visible cat features fold into SAME large plain box; reaction in-frame.
shots.soundCue: Big paper-fold magical impact then audio vacuum

shots.cameraAndAction: Wide rear silhouette of Mocha stopped at single box under streetlamp; then subtle push to his face.
ECU two deliberate taps on Essie-box; no response, no box teleport.

shots.narrationAnchor: Whispered her name / Held it close
shots.cameraAndAction: Mocha gently hugs sides and whispers to same box, head pressed against it; intact dimensions.
Tight Mocha reaction looking down; box remains partially in frame, avoid dead still hold.
Breeze curls loose paper beside lamp; Mocha shivers and edges nearer box.
POV through open flaps: visibly dry, sheltered box interior; sound of wind muffles.
Quick warm memory flashes of Latte curled under café window and Essie leaving a space beside her while inviting Mocha in; return to Mocha POV.
shots.soundCue: Two brief cozy purrs, memory melody

shots.cameraAndAction: Mocha shelters his paw inside the box and looks surprised at the warmth; warmer practical light reveals interior.
shots.soundCue: Warm major chord; fur flutter settles

shots.cameraAndAction: Eye-level on Mocha hesitating at box, then reaching decisively for flaps; emotionally motivated push.
Low side view Mocha steps into same large box, each paw supported; flaps and camera stay clear.
Locked close view: box shudders, recognizable black/white ears reform; Mocha is safely displaced back before Essie's form expands.
shots.soundCue: Three escalating taps, magical reverse fold

shots.narrationAnchor: Essie tumbled into his arms / She was back
shots.cameraAndAction: Medium: Essie reforms and tumbles into Mocha in one spatially coherent soft landing; relieved embrace.
shots.soundCue: Happy Essie meow, soft landing, music resolves

shots.cameraAndAction: Tight two-shot: Mocha and Essie exchange stunned look, then snap gaze toward café.
Tracking route from alley to café door, no jump to unrelated street; both run together.
shots.soundCue: Duet of quick paws, entering bell

shots.cameraAndAction: Window shot: Latte STRIPED box still fixed in original spot; Essie holds flaps while Mocha steps into hollow center.
Café medium: chocolate-point Latte springs free, pushing Mocha and Essie safely onto café mat; distinct meow.
shots.soundCue: Big comedic POP, Latte meow, soft tumble

shots.narrationAnchor: next morning / told the entire town
shots.cameraAndAction: Bright exterior café-front gathering with a few distinct supporting cats; Mocha speaks, Latte and Essie flank him.

shots.narrationAnchor: If someone becomes a box... climb inside
shots.cameraAndAction: Close on Mocha showing simple visual three-step diagram (box -> friend joins -> cat returns), crowd understands.

shots.narrationAnchor: They'll come back / still didn't love boxes
shots.cameraAndAction: Back in café: Mocha eyes a new LARGE SHARED box uneasily while Essie and Latte invite him in with their paws.

shots.narrationAnchor: kept one by the café window
shots.cameraAndAction: Frontal medium: distinct new extra-large box by café window, Essie and Latte already settled, Mocha climbs in with space for each.
Slow push into all three cuddled together with visible faces, warm safe smile on Mocha; cut/fade on last purr.
shots.soundCue: Original or licensed tender ending cue
